name: Horst link — seat stay drives shock
note: The seat stay carries the rear axle and pivots on the chainstay at a Horst pivot about 43mm from the axle, just in front of and below it. The chainstay pivot sits forward of the seat tube, and a short rocker (about 41mm, seat-tube bracket to link pivot) drives the shock, which hangs off the seat stay's extension to a down-tube mount, as on Specialized FSR-style Horst bikes.
